{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the 'site' column
site_distribution = trial_df['site'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of 'responded' by site
response_by_site = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Print results
missing_values, duplicates, site_distribution, response_by_site"}
